# PIC16LF (PIC14)

This page lists the PIC16LF parts that use the PIC14 core and that
`epic-cc` can target, for anyone picking a chip in this family.

| Part | Flash words | RAM bytes | EEPROM bytes | Status | Lifecycle | Datasheet |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PIC16LF627A | 1024 | 224 | 128 | experimental | Active | [datasheet](https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/aemDocuments/documents/MCU08/ProductDocuments/DataSheets/40044G.pdf) |
| PIC16LF628A | 2048 | 224 | 128 | experimental | Active | [datasheet](https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/aemDocuments/documents/MCU08/ProductDocuments/DataSheets/40044G.pdf) |
| PIC16LF873A | 4096 | 158 | 128 | experimental | Active | [datasheet](https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/aemDocuments/documents/MCU08/ProductDocuments/DataSheets/39582C.pdf) |

## Notes

- RAM bytes counts what the compiler can allocate, not the datasheet total.
- Parts with `experimental` status compile, but are not yet checked by the
  project's own test matrix.
- The full list of parts is in the [device matrix](../index.md).

## Status

See [What's in 1.0](https://apojomovsky.github.io/epic-docs/status/) for this family's support level.
